꿈을 이루기 위해서는 인내심을 갖고 기다려야 한다.

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She couldn't wait to visit museums in Madrid and see the Eiffel Tower at night in Paris. As she stood in line, she could feel those experiences were finally so close. When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. Maya reached into her pocket and felt nothing. She realized she had left her passport at home. Her plans were ruined. She was heartbroken, knowing she could not board the flight and had to delay her dream trip.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 여권을 집에 두고 옴 → 탑승 불가
det.analysis:
❌ ① 줄에서: 카운터에서 깨달음, 줄에서는 설레는 중이었음
❌ ② 반년: for a year(1년)
✅ ③ 여권 집에 두고 옴 + 탑승 불가: left passport at home + could not board ←정답
❌ ④ 탑승권: passport(여권)이지 boarding pass(탑승권) 아님

ch: Maya는 줄에 서 있는 동안 이미 여권이 없다는 것을 느꼈다.
Maya는 여행을 반년 전부터 기대해 왔다.
Maya는 여권을 집에 두고 와서 탑승하지 못했다.
